key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people were evacuated ahead of landfall in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
Subsequent floods caused 23 more deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
evidence_snippets: On 12 October 2013, Phailin crossed the coastline south of Brahmapur in Odisha
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
There were 21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods caused 23 more in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
